svg.title: Shahzad · Engineer · Voyager · Still transmitting
svg.desc: The name SHAHZAD drawn as a 1-bit dot-matrix image, received line by line like a deep-space downlink, followed by a coral full stop that beeps like Sputnik 1: 0.3 seconds on, 0.3 seconds off. Below it, a single signal trace. On the left, the ASCII bits of the letters S and A drawn as a digital waveform. On the right, the same bits modulated onto a radio carrier that heads out through a star field, growing fainter with distance past the orbits of Jupiter, Saturn and Neptune and across the heliopause, still going.

g.text: SPUTNIK BEACON ● 0.3 S ON · 0.3 S OFF
BPSK · X-BAND 8.4 GHz · RANGE IN AU, LOG
